Sandbox_SurvivorInnerVoice_Frequency_too: Controls how often lines appear. The actual interval varies randomly instead of using a fixed timer.
Sandbox_SurvivorInnerVoice_FontSize_tool: Controls the size of inner-voice lines. Defaults to Medium; vanilla state prompts always use Small.
Sandbox_SurvivorInnerVoice_ShowVanillaPr: When enabled, vanilla state titles and descriptions appear as small gray system prompts. Disable this to show inner-voice lines only.
